summary: 8 backend tests passed (deploy/check.sh bugfix), 26/26 full backend suite passed, 1 browser regression check passed (after restoring pod fixture: reinstalled missing rclone binary + recreated /tmp/fake-usb and /tmp/fake-gdrive dirs, both environmental drift unrelated to app code). All 6 acceptance criteria verified.
action_items: Pod environment drift (not an app bug): rclone binary and /tmp/fake-usb /tmp/fake-gdrive fixture dirs were missing at session start (likely wiped by a container restart). Reinstalled rclone via apt and recreated the fixture dirs so the Google Drive 'Terhubung' / flashdisk panels work as the briefing expects. If the pod is restarted again, these will need to be restored again (apt-get install -y rclone; mkdir -p /tmp/fake-usb/WARUNG-BACKUP /tmp/fake-gdrive) since /tmp and non-persisted apt packages do not survive restarts.
